req.title: Empty player list returns empty array
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players when the table is empty with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array.
triggers: empty player list returns empty array

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-025 requires that GET /players/ returns HTTP 200 with an empty JSON array when the player table is empty. The test suite must cover: (1) positive case — empty table yields 200 + []; (2) negative case — verifying the endpoint does NOT return a non-200 status or non-array body when the table is empty; (3) boundary case — the response body is exactly [] (zero elements, not null, not {}, not a non-empty array). Because the default fixture pre-loads 26 rows, we must override the DB session dependency to inject an empty in-memory SQLite session. We mock player_service.retrieve_all_async to return [] to isolate the route layer cleanly and avoid DB setup complexity. Each test asserts exact status code (200, not >=200) and exact body ([], not just list type) to kill status-code and return-value mutations.

import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache

async def _clear_cache():
    await simple_memory_cache.clear('players')

asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear_cache())

def test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    with patch('routes.player_route.player_service.retrieve_all_async', new=AsyncMock(return_value=[])):
        async def _clear():
            await simple_memory_cache.clear('players')
        asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_clear())
        client = TestClient(app)
        response = client.get('/players/')
        assert response.status_code == 200
        body = response.json()
        assert body == []
        assert isinstance(body, list)
        assert len(body) == 0
        assert 'application/json' in response.headers['content-type']

test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array()

import asyncio
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY, CACHE_TTL

def test_get_players_cache_hit_path_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    async def _seed_cache():
        await simple_memory_cache.set(CACHE_KEY, [], ttl=CACHE_TTL)
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(_seed_cache())
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.headers.get('x-cache') == 'HIT'
    body = response.json()
    assert body == []
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 0

test_get_players_cache_hit_path_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array()
